name: Halvorly Mutual
summary: A policyholder-owned regional mutual and our longest appointment. Strong on older homes and multi-car families.
body: Halvorly writes personal lines in four states (story). Its homeowners form includes water backup at a higher default limit than most, which matters in the river wards.

name: Quarrow Fire & Casualty
summary: A national carrier with broad appetite and a 24-hour claims line. Often the most competitive on newer homes.
body: Quarrow's strength is breadth: one carrier for home, auto, umbrella and a small business. Bundled clients see the largest discounts here.

name: Ostrine Indemnity
summary: Auto and workers' compensation specialist with telematics programs for teen drivers and fleets.
body: Ostrine is our first call for families adding a teen driver and for contractors with three or more vehicles.

name: Belcaster Mutual
summary: A farm-and-main-street mutual that still sends local adjusters. Good fit for landlords and small shops.
body: Belcaster underwrites by hand, which is slower and often kinder to unusual properties: mixed-use buildings, older wiring that has been documented, a duplex over a storefront.

name: Marlinth Flood Underwriters
summary: Private flood with higher limits and shorter waiting periods than the federal program in some cases.
body: We quote Marlinth next to the federal program for every flood client. In the story, private flood is cheaper for about a third of homes outside the mapped zone.

name: Wendmere Specialty
summary: Excess and specialty lines: high-value homes, larger umbrella limits, and businesses standard carriers decline.
body: Wendmere is where we go when a standard carrier says no: a restaurant with a liquor license, a 10-unit rental portfolio, or an umbrella above $5 million.

name: Tollan Ridge Life
summary: Term life and individual disability income, with simplified underwriting for smaller face amounts.
body: Tollan Ridge offers term up to 30 years and own-occupation disability for professionals. Many clients under 45 qualify without a medical exam (story).

name: Corrabin Casualty
summary: Main-street commercial lines with fast certificate turnaround and pay-as-you-go workers' comp.
body: Corrabin's pay-as-you-go workers' comp bills premium with each payroll run, so the year-end audit has few surprises.

name: Saddlecombe Home & Auto
summary: A newer national carrier with simple renters and auto policies and an app-first claims process.
body: Saddlecombe is usually the lowest renters premium we see and is a good fit for first-time renters and young drivers.

name: Esklow Commercial
summary: Specialty commercial for contractors and light manufacturing.
body: Esklow writes trades that many carriers avoid, including roofing and tree work, with safety-program credits.
